ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Matthew 6:1–2 is translated from Tolstoy's Russian with lowercase 'father' as printed, not from a familiar Bible version. «Юродство» (yurodstvo) is rendered 'holy foolishness', the usual English name for this Russian practice; the opening thought keeps Francis of Assisi's chain of clauses as one italic sentence, which the website draft had split and shortened.
